laws: Restaurant menu is a projection over SO1 catalog entries; R2 does not create Atomic Unit, offer, catalog, or price authority.
Modifier groups/options own Restaurant choice and preparation semantics; optional commercial targets/prices remain SO1 references and snapshots.
SO5 owns station/resource identity; R2 only profiles Restaurant preparation use and routing intent.
Preparation tickets own kitchen/bar preparation state, hold/fire/course, fan-out and partial readiness; SO8 owns durable delivery jobs, retries, devices and providers.
Routing rules may consume SC41 semantic classification through a resolver; R2 stores routing intent but does not own semantic truth.
Preparation specifications own recipes, sub-preparation dependencies, operational yield and waste evidence; SO3 owns inventory positions, reservations and movements.
Preparation release may select an explicit subset of R1 order lines for course firing; duplicate non-voided release of the same line to the same station/course is rejected.
R2 never posts Finance, creates obligations, settles payments, or defines universal inventory costing.
WND kitchen printing is a migration specimen; KDS, kitchen printers, bars, expo, pastry, prep and pickup stations are equally valid endpoints.
Restaurant pack supports full-service, quick-service, takeaway/delivery, bar/pub, cafeteria and cloud-kitchen models without source forks.
